The doc holds scanner settings, display defaults, the fixation mark, design-wide jitter, the hours budget, media (pictures by sha256), prompt lists (columns + items), trial_types (phases with durations and layers; a layer value written {column} is filled from the trial's prompt item; a duration with inherit set follows doc.jitter), runs (blocks of trial types) and sessions (steps, each with a repeat count).

post.description: One small edit, without sending the whole document. action is <thing>.<verb>: things are list, item, trial, phase, run, block, session, step; verbs are add (fields; returns the new id), update (id, fields; only those fields change), delete (id; refused while something uses it) and move (id, position from 0). An item needs list, a phase trial, a block run, a step session: each the parent's id. Also settings.update (section: scanner, display, keys, budget, limits, hrf, jitter, fixation or meta; fields) and experiment.update (fields: name, notes). A new thing needs only the fields you care about; the rest get their defaults.
